rationale: Read all asynchronous controls and baseline/fixed expectations, including 128 probe generations, 16 remembered generations and five contexts. Bundles actual cache/coalescer/parser with only command and generation ports inert. Uses small host-list WeakRefs with forced GC and a ten-second deadline; restores Date.now and deletes global symbol. Current exact patch cannot reverse evolved cache, so all scenarios remain historical.

cases.title: 128 successful generations retain old-only arrays and cache the latest result
cases.reason: Actual cache and coalescer with controlled generation/command-result ports; verifies returned hosts, 128 probe calls, original 128 versus fixed one reachable array, and zero retained after reset.

cases.title: old completion after explicit reset cannot repopulate the fixed cache
cases.reason: Deferred actual probe is reset before completion; old caller receives its own result, but fixed next lookup must run fresh rather than reusing the old result.

cases.title: late retired-generation result is collectible while successor stays cached
cases.reason: Settles new generation first, then old; requires original retained versus fixed collectable old WeakRef and preserved successor hosts.

cases.title: remembered hosts across 16 generations retain only current fixed array
cases.reason: Actual remembered-host API must avoid command probes, return normalized expected hosts and retain original 16 versus fixed one result arrays.

cases.title: abandoned stale probe cannot append its host to replacement cache
cases.reason: Drives actual coalescer stale threshold with restored Date.now, resolves successor then stale result; requires baseline merged stale host versus fixed unchanged successor.

cases.title: remembered hosts survive pending probe success
cases.reason: Actually remembers normalized/deduplicated host while probe pending; both old promise and cache must return remembered host after successful completion.

cases.title: remembered hosts survive pending probe failure
cases.reason: Same real remembered-host update with rejected command-result promise; old caller and cache both preserve remembered host.
